info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-Create Meetings Meetings Schedule-v2-spec
info.description: The Schedule Meetings API enables users to efficiently book and manage meetings within the organization. This API allows for the creation of meeting schedules, which can include details such as participants, timing, and agenda. It is particularly useful for project managers and team leads who need to coordinate meetings across various teams and resources. By leveraging this API, developers can streamline the scheduling process and enhance collaboration within applications.

post.description: This endpoint allows users to schedule a new meeting by providing the necessary details. Ensure that all required fields are filled to successfully create the meeting.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to schedule a meeting. The body must adhere to the specified JSON schema, which includes details such as the meeting title, participants, time, and duration. Ensure that all required fields are included to successfully schedule the meeting.

204.description: The meeting was scheduled successfully and no content is returned.
